name: Merenberg (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of green and yellow, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Merenberg (a yellow saltire between crosses on green).
history: Municipal flag of Merenberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Merenberg arms — saltire and crosses on green
